title: Newsweek: How AI, Diagnostics and Clinical Research Are Converging to Create a More Personalized Future of Health Care
summary: In a Q&A with Newsweek, Bola Oyegunwa, Ph.D., EVP and chief information and technology officer at Labcorp, explains how AI is transforming diagnostics, drug development and the patient experience to move healthcare toward a more personalized future.
body_markdown:
In a Q&A with *Newsweek* , Bola Oyegunwa, Ph.D., EVP and chief information and technology officer at Labcorp, explains how AI is transforming diagnostics, drug development and the patient experience to move healthcare toward a more personalized future.


**Key takeaway:** AI is converging with diagnostics and clinical research to deliver faster, more personalized care, from accelerating drug discovery to turning lab data into actionable patient insights.


Labcorp is putting this into practice through its AI-powered Test Finder, which helps clinicians identify the right test using natural language, and the MyLabcorp app, which consolidates lab results and AI-enabled insights for consumers.


**By the numbers:** More than 4 million users downloaded the MyLabcorp app in less than two months, underscoring consumer demand for actionable health insights.


Through collaboration with AWS and Datavant, Labcorp is applying AI to large-scale real-world data, turning months of preparation and analysis into minutes and accelerating the journey from clinical research to patient care.


**Why it matters:** As diagnostics move beyond individual biomarkers toward a comprehensive view of patient health, AI-enabled tools are helping providers make earlier, more personalized decisions that improve outcomes and lower the cost of bringing therapies to market.
